title: Slack (send messages)
description: Sends a message to a Slack channel through a Slack app's bot token: a message.send connector. Text only. For a channel an agent answers in, add Slack (messages), which reads the channel too.
setup_notes: Create a Slack app at api.slack.com/apps, add the chat:write scope under OAuth & Permissions, install it to your workspace and copy the Bot User OAuth Token (it starts xoxb-). Invite the app to the channel (/invite @your-app). The channel id is in the channel's details, at the bottom. Run Test on its row under Admin > Extensions > Connectors, which posts a short test message. Nothing in gohort sends through a send-only connector yet; Slack (messages) is the one a linked service uses. Its key is given where it is used, under the choice, or under Settings on its row in Admin > Extensions > Connectors.

questions.name: name
questions.label: Connector name
questions.help: Lowercase letters, digits, dashes and underscores; a flow's step names it.

config.name: channel
config.label: Channel id
config.help: Where messages go unless a flow's step says otherwise (its to input), e.g. C0123456789.

config.name: bot_token

config.help: Kept with this connection, and sent only to the address it is given for.
